subtitle: Tasty for children, healthy for families!

benefits.title: Healthier option!
benefits.description: These noodles are made of 87% of grains - making it one of the most healthiest snack

benefits.title: NO MAIDA and MSG
benefits.description: Say goodbye to heavy maida and MSG; these noodles are light on the stomach and gentle on health, ensuring easy digestion without worries.

ingredients.name: Brown Rice Protein
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Brown Rice

Our pediatricians say:The complex carbohydrates in brown rice promote feelings of satiation, keeping kids’ tummies full and happy. Brown rice contains a whole host of micronutrients that are useful in helping kids’ body and brain develop.

ingredients.name: Pea Protein
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Pea

Our pediatricians say:The peas that your kids are constantly trying to avoid? They're actually complete sources of protein so the more peas your kids eat, the hap-pea-er they’ll be!

ingredients.name: Moong Dal Protein
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Moong Dal

Our pediatricians say:Moong dal is considered to be one of the best plant-based sources of protein and can do wonders for your kid's hair, skin, nails and growth. The folate in moong dal boosts bone marrow and brain function.

ingredients.name: Ragi
ingredients.shortDesc: Our nutritionists say: Ragi is a household name in India. Known for its high calcium and protein content, ragi is the perfect grain to mix into your kid's foods for maximum health.

ingredients.name: Bajra
ingredients.shortDesc: Our nutritionists say: High in iron and rich in dietary fibres, bajra is an Indian millet superfood that reduces long term illnesses and is packed with nutrients, vitamins and minerals.

fullIngredientsList: Classic Noodles: Multigrain Blend 89% [Whole wheat flour (Atta) , Split moong beans flour (Moong dal) , Oats flour , Brown rice flour , Jowar flour , Ragi flour , Bajra flour ], Guar gum, Tapioca starch, Salt. Seasoning: Classic Masala Blend (Chilli, Coriander, Turmeric, Cumin, Fennel, Fenugreek, Pepper, Onion, Garlic, Tomato, Tamarind, Mango, Salt), Desi Khand, Acidity Regulator (Ascorbic acid/Vitamin C), Wheat fiber, Natural colour (Paprika Extract, Curcumin Extract) Contains Natural & Nature Identical Flavouring Substances (Masala, Garlic)

description:
😎 Discover the healthy twist to your favourite Multigrain Noodles!

💪 Enjoy guilt-free snacking with noodles FREE from Maida, Preservatives, and MSG.

✅ Loaded with 89% Multi-Grain Blend

✅ 10g of protein in every packet 

😍 Choose your flavor: Classic Masala for a zing or Tangy Masala for extra zest!

Step 1: Boil 350 ml of water.

Step 2: Add noodles and seasoning masala to the boiling water. Cook for 8 - 10 minutes.

Step 3: Serve hot and enjoy.

For 2–3 year olds, please check with your nutritionist before serving.

reviews.author: Indrneel Awasthi
reviews.title: Excellent alternative to traditional noodles
reviews.body: These noodles boast an exceptional blend of spices and seasonings that tantalize the taste buds, making them a delectable treat for any food lover. Moreover, they offer an excellent alternative to traditional noodles, as they are both healthy and delicious. As someone who loves to indulge in a guilty pleasure occasionally, I can wholeheartedly recommend these noodles to anyone seeking a flavorful and wholesome meal.
